title: Execution of the Romanov Family
summary: In the early hours of 17 July 1918 the former emperor Nicholas II, Alexandra and their five children were shot in a basement room of the Ipatiev House in Yekaterinburg. Commandant Yakov Yurovsky had the family line up in the basement beforehand. The bodies were thrown into an abandoned mineshaft, then buried; in 1998 bones from the larger grave were interred in the Peter and Paul Cathedral.

uncertainty.note: Night of 16-17 July 1918 per Hoover; early hours of 17 July per The Moscow Times.
